name: Unsplash
summary:
Unsplash is the photo library at unsplash.com. The slash mark in the tab is the icon collection bookmarks use. A login wall with no image is not published.

Checked 12 November 2026 against unsplash.com. HTML came from https://unsplash.com/.within.website?redir=%2F (HTTP 401). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://unsplash.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4286 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://unsplash.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 165 bytes) from https://unsplash.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
